results.name: Delayed GET cannot replace newer snapshot
Lower version of same UID cannot regress even on a later response
Lost response retains identical command ID payload URL and method; replay uses current
Command invalidates outstanding read; same client serializes writes
Definitive rejection releases intent; 401 and 503 preserve the identical retry
Unicode and legacy route UIDs preserve UTF8 without changing stored ID
Successful reconnection clears a read failure without dropping a pending command
Accent contrast preserves default ink and adapts purple and middle gray
Monotonic interpolation is visual only and stops at zero or unconfirmed/hidden state
Authenticated transport has CSRF no-store timeout cleanup and retains error status
